features.description: Engineered with smart automation and precision technology for reliable, efficient, and high-performance textile printing

items.title: Scalable Printhead Configuration
items.desc: Supports 8, 16, or 24 single-channel Kyocera printheads, letting you configure the machine to your exact production volume and scale capacity as your business grows.

items.title: De-Wrinkle System
items.desc: Best-in-class wrinkle control sensors ensure smooth, flat fabric feeding for accurate, defect-free printing across all fabric types and weights.

items.title: Auto Ripping and Click-to-Print
items.desc: Integrated onboard storage allows instant design access and eliminates pre-print delays so operators can start production in seconds.

items.title: Symmetrical Ink Supply System
items.desc: Balanced ink pressure across all channels minimises colour deviation and delivers vivid, consistent colour reproduction throughout long production runs.

items.title: Moving Roll Conveyor System
items.desc: Reduces fabric tension during feeding for smoother, more stable media transport and higher print registration accuracy.

items.title: Real-Time Ink and Air Pressure Monitoring
items.desc: Continuously tracks system pressure across ink and air circuits, preventing interruptions and maintaining stable output under all operating conditions.

items.title: Head Crash Protective System
items.desc: Sensor-driven protection detects fabric obstructions during carriage movement and immediately safeguards printheads from damage.

items.title: Automatic Capping and Wiping System
items.desc: Automated printhead maintenance prevents ink drying between runs, keeps nozzles clean, and extends printhead operational life across multi-shift production.

idealFor.description: Perfectly suited for a wide range of textile applications, delivering exceptional print quality, color vibrancy, and production efficiency across diverse fabric categories.

fabrics.title: Home Textile Manufacturing
fabrics.desc: Bedding, curtains, cushion covers, and upholstery across cotton and polyester substrates, with the capacity to handle multiple buyer orders simultaneously.

fabrics.title: Jacquard and Textured Fabrics
fabrics.desc: High-resolution output on complex woven and jacquard structures for fashion and home furnishing applications requiring sharp pattern definition.

fabrics.title: Silk and Luxury Fabrics
fabrics.desc: Precise acid ink printing on silk, viscose, and premium fabrics for boutique fashion producers and luxury garment manufacturers.
